title: A .env KEY is never validated: fabrik.env_file.format_env_line writes any key raw, so a key holding a newline, '=' or a space (from a spec env: name, a secret name or an override) injects or corrupts .env lines on the VPS; no key grammar exists in spec_loader, deployer_ssh or secrets. Found measuring W-8495d72f (which refuses only a NUL in the key).
